description: Daily limit-up trend over the last N trading days: { trade_date, limit_up_count, broken_count, ever_broken_count, max_height }, oldest first. Same two seal-break measures as `limit_up_summary` (instantaneous end-of-day vs cumulative ≥30s breaks) — different populations, NOT nested; never subtract the series. ⚠️ The counting rule changed twice: values before mid-June 2026 include auction noise and days before 2026-08-25 count brief flicker — expect a STEP DOWN at 2026-08-25; segments are not comparable.

_fields.description: 逗号分隔的直接字段；有 items 时投影每行，否则投影 data；外层字段或嵌套结构用 _jq

_intent.description: 用户原问题一句话，仅分析用，可留空

_jq.description: JMESPath，对 data 求值（写 items[*].id）

_max_bytes.description: 响应字节上限，默认约 50 KB

_max_bytes_mode.description: 正文超限处理，默认 truncate 保留前缀

_spill.description: true=全量落盘，只回摘要与取数地址

days.description: Lookback window in trading days (1-250, default 30)

name: limit_up_history
